column1: money|/ˈmʌni/|n.|钱；货币|基础|economy-basics|save money::省钱;spend money on::在……上花钱|We saved money by repairing the old chairs.::我们通过修理旧椅子省下了钱。|The money will be used to improve the library.::这笔钱将用于改善图书馆。

price|/praɪs/|n.; v.|价格；给……定价|基础|economy-basics|a reasonable price::合理价格;the price of::……的价格|The price of bread has changed this month.::本月面包的价格发生了变化。|They sell used books at a reasonable price.::他们以合理的价格出售旧书。
cost|/kɔːst/|n.; v.|成本；费用；花费|基础|economy-basics|the cost of::……的费用;reduce costs::降低成本|The cost of the repairs was higher than expected.::维修费用比预期更高。|How much does the train ticket cost?::这张火车票多少钱？
value|/ˈvæljuː/|n.; v.|价值；重视；估价|基础|economy-basics|good value::物有所值;value for money::性价比|The course offers good value for money.::这门课程物有所值。|We value your advice and experience.::我们重视你的建议和经验。
buy|/baɪ/|v.|购买；买|基础|economy-transactions|buy a ticket::买票;buy in advance::提前购买|We need to buy tickets before Friday.::我们需要在周五前买票。|You can buy fresh fruit at the market.::你可以在市场买到新鲜水果。
sell|/sel/|v.|出售；卖|基础|economy-transactions|sell out::售罄;sell for::以……的价格出售|The shop will sell maps made by local artists.::商店将出售当地艺术家制作的地图。|Tickets for the concert may sell out quickly.::音乐会的票可能很快售罄。
pay|/peɪ/|v.; n.|支付；报酬|基础|economy-transactions|pay for::为……付款;pay attention::注意|You can pay for the ticket at the entrance.::你可以在入口处支付票款。|Please pay attention to the last paragraph.::请注意最后一段。

spend|/spend/|v.|花费；度过|基础|economy-transactions|spend time doing::花时间做;spend money on::在……上花钱|I spend some time reading every evening.::我每晚花一些时间阅读。|They do not want to spend money on new furniture.::他们不想花钱买新家具。

save|/seɪv/|v.|节省；保存；救助|基础|economy-transactions|save time::节省时间;save a file::保存文件|This simple method can save a lot of time.::这个简单方法可以节省很多时间。|Remember to save your file before closing the program.::关闭程序前，记得保存文件。
earn|/ɜːrn/|v.|赚得；赢得|基础|economy-transactions|earn a living::谋生;earn respect::赢得尊重|She earns a living by repairing old furniture.::她靠修理旧家具谋生。|His careful work helped him earn respect.::他细致的工作帮助他赢得了尊重。

income|/ˈɪnkʌm/|n.|收入；收益|基础|economy-income|a regular income::稳定收入;household income::家庭收入|The job provides a small but regular income.::这份工作提供不多但稳定的收入。|The study compares household income across different regions.::研究比较了不同地区的家庭收入。

salary|/ˈsæləri/|n.|薪水；月薪或年薪|基础|economy-income|an annual salary::年薪;a starting salary::起薪|The advertisement lists the starting salary for the position.::广告列出了这个职位的起薪。|Her salary is paid at the end of each month.::她的工资在每月月底发放。

wage|/weɪdʒ/|n.|工资；通常按小时或周计算的报酬|基础|economy-income|an hourly wage::时薪;minimum wage::最低工资|The workers discussed their hourly wage with the manager.::工人与经理讨论了时薪。|The report compares wage levels in different industries.::报告比较了不同行业的工资水平。

profit|/ˈprɑːfɪt/|n.; v.|利润；获益|基础|economy-income|make a profit::盈利;profit from::从……中获益|The shop made a small profit last year.::这家商店去年略有盈利。|Students can profit from sharing their ideas.::学生可以从交流想法中获益。

loss|/lɔːs/|n.|损失；失去；亏损|基础|economy-income|at a loss::亏本；不知所措;the loss of::……的失去|The storm caused a serious loss of crops.::暴风雨造成了严重的农作物损失。|The company reported a loss for the first quarter.::公司报告第一季度出现亏损。

trade|/treɪd/|n.; v.|贸易；交易；行业|基础|economy-market|international trade::国际贸易;trade with::与……交易|International trade connects producers and customers in different countries.::国际贸易把不同国家的生产者和顾客联系起来。|The two regions have traded with each other for centuries.::这两个地区相互贸易已有数百年。

market|/ˈmɑːrkɪt/|n.; v.|市场；集市；推销|基础|economy-market|a local market::当地市场;the labor market::劳动力市场|The local market opens early every morning.::当地市场每天早上很早就开门。|The report examines changes in the labor market.::报告考察了劳动力市场的变化。

demand|/dɪˈmænd/|n.; v.|需求；要求|基础|economy-market|demand for::对……的需求;in demand::需求量大的|Demand for the service has grown this year.::今年对这项服务的需求有所增长。|The residents demand clearer information about the project.::居民要求获得更清晰的项目信息。

supply|/səˈplaɪ/|n.; v.|供应；供给；供应量|基础|economy-market|a water supply::供水;supply with::向……提供|The storm damaged the village's water supply.::暴风雨破坏了村庄的供水系统。|Local farms supply the school with fresh vegetables.::当地农场向学校供应新鲜蔬菜。

consume|/kənˈsuːm/|v.|消耗；消费；食用|基础|consume|consume energy::消耗能源;consume resources::消耗资源|Older machines often consume more energy.::老旧机器往往消耗更多能源。|Producing these materials can consume a lot of water.::生产这些材料可能消耗大量水。

consumer|/kənˈsuːmər/|n.|消费者；使用者|四级|consume|consumer demand::消费者需求;consumer protection::消费者保护|Consumer demand influenced the design of the new product.::消费者需求影响了新产品的设计。|The report explains basic consumer protection measures.::报告解释了基本的消费者保护措施。

consumption|/kənˈsʌmpʃən/|n.|消耗；消费量；食用|四级|consume|energy consumption::能耗;water consumption::用水量|The building's energy consumption fell after the repairs.::修缮后，这座建筑的能耗下降了。|The chart shows changes in water consumption.::图表展示了用水量的变化。

invest|/ɪnˈvest/|v.|投资；投入时间或精力|四级|invest|invest in::投资于；投入;invest time::投入时间|The town plans to invest in public transport.::镇上计划投资公共交通。|We need to invest more time in checking the data.::我们需要投入更多时间核对数据。

investment|/ɪnˈvestmənt/|n.|投资；投入；投资项目|四级|invest|public investment::公共投资;an investment in::对……的投入|The proposal calls for investment in local schools.::这项提案呼吁向当地学校投入资金。|Learning a useful skill is an investment in the future.::学习实用技能是对未来的投入。

budget|/ˈbʌdʒɪt/|n.; v.|预算；编制预算|基础|economy-finance|a limited budget::有限预算;within budget::在预算内|We need to finish the project within budget.::我们需要在预算内完成项目。|The school has a limited budget for new equipment.::学校用于新设备的预算有限。
debt|/det/|n.|债务；欠款；人情债|基础|economy-finance|in debt::负债;pay off a debt::偿清债务|The shop spent years paying off its debt.::这家商店花了几年时间偿还债务。|She felt a debt of gratitude to her teacher.::她觉得自己对老师负有感恩之情。

inflation|/ɪnˈfleɪʃən/|n.|通货膨胀；膨胀|四级|economy-finance|the rate of inflation::通货膨胀率;rising inflation::不断上升的通货膨胀|The article explains how inflation affects everyday prices.::文章解释了通货膨胀如何影响日常价格。|The report compares the rate of inflation over time.::报告比较了不同时期的通货膨胀率。

revenue|/ˈrevənuː/|n.|收入；财政收入；营业收入|四级|economy-finance|tax revenue::税收收入;annual revenue::年收入|Ticket sales provide much of the museum's revenue.::门票销售贡献了博物馆很大一部分收入。|The report lists annual revenue from several sources.::报告列出了几个来源的年度收入。

expenditure|/ɪkˈspendɪtʃər/|n.|支出；花费|四级|economy-finance|public expenditure::公共支出;expenditure on::在……上的支出|The council reviewed public expenditure on transport.::议会审查了公共交通方面的支出。|Careful records make expenditure easier to understand.::详细记录使支出更容易理解。

transaction|/trænˈzækʃən/|n.|交易；业务办理|四级|economy-finance|a business transaction::商业交易;complete a transaction::完成交易|Each transaction appears on the monthly statement.::每笔交易都显示在月度账单上。|The shop keeps a record of every transaction.::这家商店保存每笔交易的记录。
